answer: Bind each established identity to one physical TPM: the host signs a fresh nonce with its vendor-certified endorsement key, and the network stores only a salted nullifier, so one chip backs one seat per season. Fifty clones on one server whisper the same nullifier; the second is simply refused, with no ripple onto the first. Checking costs a zephyr of compute: one signature. Evasion: buy cheap boards or use leaked vendor keys, so revoke bad batches; virtual TPMs don't count. Wrongly hit: honest agents on cloud VMs or shared family PCs; give them a slower bonded lane, never a ban.
